ratingsOriginalSchema.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed but playable with substantial friction; 7 good with meaningful rough edges; 10 exceptional and consistently clear within assessed scope. Subjective observed-interface grades, not win/loss grades or certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: A coherent, atmospheric mission was navigable and completable with useful mobile assists. Combat inputs worked in short manually directed samples, but substantial aim/route assistance and frequent paused observation limit conclusions about sustained mobile play.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag worked for visible patrols; swipes turned predictably in the sampled scene; DASH gave visible cooldown feedback. Aim taps rotate the view substantially, and dash/route interaction was uncertain. Continuous hold comfort and thumb ergonomics unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, distinct coil phases and defending an upload provided understandable stages. Choosing visible patrols and seeing explicit down feedback was satisfying in the observed short interactions. Protected-phase firing, reload interruptions and offscreen attackers added friction. No inference about longer-term enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Rain, lighting, teal/orange palette and station signage provide a coherent atmosphere. Low-poly silhouettes are readable at close range; audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Route/approach transitions, clear objective names, recovery checkmarks, map route and terminal stats support progress. No checkpoint or recovery menu needed, so those flows unassessed.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo, objective and target feedback are legible at 844x390. Small world labels and dense overlapping right-side controls/threat cues take more attention.

coverage.manual_move_fire_drag: Entry guard TARGET DOWN; visible perimeter patrol selected after left scene turn, simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag registered SENTINEL DOWN. Ammo 21 to 18 on patrol; assisted aim used. No individual shot misses distinguishable; end UI reports 100% accuracy.
coverage.scene_turn: 354 to 015 with right swipe; 315 to 278 with left swipe to expose patrol. Patrol tap and fire drag changed heading to 245; required reorientation.
coverage.dash: Tapped visible DASH after scene turn; cyan effect, displacement toward wall, cooldown 4.3 visible. No phase evade credited; no claim of successful dodge.
coverage.map: Opened planning map, inspected selected Extraction and 23m route, closed visibly.
coverage.mission: Used HOLD ROUTE/HOLD APPROACH for recoveries, aimed and fired at coils, auto reload at zero, remained on deck to upload.

helpful: Directional threat cues and route/approach prompts
Map extraction selection and route length
Explicit armor/charge/open boss HUD and upload percent
friction: Needed a left scene turn to locate patrol beyond offscreen cue
Small dark world labels harder to read than HUD
Fire into armor/charge reduced coil II only to 15% before reload; next burst completed it
Rear threats caused shield damage while focusing coils; upload also took damage
uncertainties: Not all spent rounds can be classified as hits versus protected-phase fire from screenshots
Automatic capture breaks holds; no continuous rearming assessment
Dash was sampled outside a charge interception; no evasion success established

attempts.fresh_start: Visible START FRESH tapped as #play-again in act with capture, after attempt one was saved to this report. No checkpoint retry.

coverage.manual_move_fire_drag: Entry guard TARGET DOWN with simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag. Visible west patrol at left edge: target tap plus simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag, 21 to 19 ammo, SENTINEL DOWN. Visible east patrol: target tap plus simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag, 19 to 16 ammo, SENTINEL DOWN. Deck: stationary FIRE drag after tap registered INTERCEPTOR DOWN; another fresh-view target tap/FIRE registered another INTERCEPTOR DOWN.
coverage.scene_turn: No independent scene swipe this attempt; tap aims changed headings (303 to 256 on west patrol, 108 to 148 on east patrol, 346 to 004 then 353 on deck). Independent scene-swipe coverage was attempt one.
coverage.dash: Visible DASH tapped in open travel after entry guard. Next screenshot showed cooldown 1.5 and West Archive 45m away. Route did not make expected progress in same batch; separate hold resumed travel. Cause uncertain; no successful evade inferred. End stats credit zero phase evades.
coverage.mission: Followed visible route and approach prompts, recovered all three, shot current visible coils, automatic reload, returned to deck and fired at two visible threats while uploading.
coverage.unassessed: No map, tools, zoom, jump, settings changes or independent scene swipe in this attempt.

helpful: Target-down messages confirmed west/east patrol and deck engagements
Receiver badges and objective names made progress explicit
Coil II remaining 37% identified unfinished work before automatic reload
Upload percent and stay-on-deck instruction were clear
friction: Aim assist substantially changed heading, requiring reorientation
Dash-plus-route batch ended with archive still 45m away; route resumed in next batch, cause uncertain
Shield fell to 34 on boss approach despite eliminating both visible perimeter patrols
Coil II burst exhausted magazine at 37%; another burst needed after reload
Threat cue and many controls occupy substantial scene area
misses_and_corrections: No individual missed shot distinguishable; terminal UI reported 100% accuracy, with 16 assisted shots, so this is not an unaided precision claim
Did not disable coil II in first burst; resumed firing after reload and saw COIL II OFF
Resumed route hold separately after dash/travel batch
Rechecked view after each target tap changed projection before selecting next target
uncertainties: Dash effect versus route interaction not isolated
Some screenshots and beforePause metadata differed slightly (e.g. upload percent/shield), consistent with capture occurring live; screenshots remain evidence rather than exact simultaneous state
Continuous held-burst rearming comfort cannot be established because every capture releases contacts

ratingsOriginalSchema.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but playable with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable friction, 9 excellent with minor friction, 10 exceptional across assessed scope. Subjective holistic judgments of observed emulated mobile use, not averages or win-based grades. Unassessed features receive no implied credit.

overall_mobile.reason: Clear objective progression, distinctive atmosphere and useful touch assistance supported two complete runs. Losing enemies during movement/aim correction, small distant targets and route wall-facing moments reduced control confidence. Paused observation limits confidence in sustained play.

controls.reason: Large reachable controls, tap aim and simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag worked on visible patrols. Opening second-run drag failed to finish target; reacquiring required two turns. DASH activated but no evade established; continuous holds not assessed.

gameplay.reason: Recovery, armor/open coil phases and vulnerable upload create understandable changes of task. Patrol combat and reload added pressure. Much travel used route assistance, limiting assessment of independent navigation and longer-term depth.

presentation.reason: Rain, angular industrial structures, cyan/orange lighting and coherent typography give a strong visual identity. Dark grey scenes can hide small threats; audio unassessed.

usability.reason: Contextual hold labels, progress badges, map route, reload label and detailed terminal statistics help recover from uncertainty. Entry finding and wall-facing route moments still caused friction.

readability.reason: Main health/ammo, objective and touch controls readable at 390x844; distant enemies, world labels and small secondary text harder to resolve.

coverage.manual_move_fire_drag: Opening warden and visible perimeter sentinel; each used simultaneous left MOVE drag and right FIRE drag after scene aim tap. Three rounds per engagement; DOWN feedback. Tap-assisted, not unassisted aiming.
coverage.turn: Scene swipes changed 003 to 327 and 315 to 251; second found patrol.
coverage.dash: Tapped visible DASH after opening engagement; turquoise effect and 4.3 cooldown visible. No incoming charge present; evasion success unassessed.
coverage.map: Opened at MAP FIND ENTRY; read route and closed visibly.
coverage.misses_corrections: No recorded shot misses (terminal 100%); initial turn did not expose a patrol, later offscreen cue prompted another turn. Last coil unavailable from first approach; map and route used to correct position.

helpful: Opening instruction ties tap aim, FIRE, scene swipe and DASH together.
Tap aim plus two-contact MOVE/FIRE produced warden and patrol DOWN feedback.
HOLD ROUTE changing to HOLD APPROACH plus completed-name badges made recovery legible.
Map showed 14m route around cover to Custodian approach; closed visibly.
Coil percentages, OPEN timer and OFF state explained progress.
Upload percent and terminal assist counts make outcome transparent.
frustrating: Threat cue LEFT did not identify an on-screen enemy until another substantial scene turn.
Route waypoint briefly left camera close to a wall, reducing spatial context.
Coil I lacked an aim prompt from initial firing position; MAP FIND ENTRY and a new position resolved this.
observations.tried: Manual opening combat, scene turns, manual perimeter patrol combat, DASH outside a charge, route/approach holds, map, three labeled coil aims and held FIRE, deck upload.
uncertainties: No successful phase evade; terminal 0 phase evades.
No manual shot misses established; terminal accuracy is game-reported, not independently measured.
Last preterminal health/shield are not terminal stats.
Recovered-memory reading, tools, zoom and jump not sampled.

coverage.manual_move_fire_drag: Opening guard attempt used simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag after tap aim; two rounds spent but guard remained. Later visible patrol at route6 used tap aim plus simultaneous MOVE/FIRE drag, three rounds spent and SENTINEL DOWN.
coverage.turn: Two scene swipes corrected offscreen guard search: 000 to 300 to 254; charging WARDEN then visible.
coverage.dash: Visible DASH tapped near opening guard; cooldown 2.9 appeared. Guard ended offscreen left and subsequent charge cost shield (60 to 51 by downing). No successful evade established; terminal 0 phase evades.
coverage.map: Not opened in attempt 2; applied route learning from attempt 1.
coverage.reload: Magazine emptied on coil I with 58% remaining. Waited 2000ms with no contact; fresh image showed 30/330. New visible aim tap and FIRE contact finished coil. This breaks the hold and cannot assess continuous rearming.
coverage.misses_corrections: Initial two FIRE-drag rounds did not down guard. DASH followed by one scene aim tap and FIRE in same batch did not establish a hit; tap used pre-DASH view, so correction is uncertain and not claimed successful. Two fresh-view scene turns then reacquired guard; eight rounds and shield loss preceded TARGET DOWN. Terminal 94% confirms misses overall but cannot localize each miss. Final coil required reload and reacquisition.
coverage.other: All three recoveries, three coils and upload completed. Fired at a visible deck attacker: SENTINEL DOWN, shield 60 to 47. Tools, zoom, jump and memory reading unassessed.

helpful: Threat directions guided guard reacquisition after losing it from view.
Patrol DOWN feedback followed simultaneous manual movement and FIRE drag.
Automatic reload clearly labeled RELOADING and restored full magazine.
Coil percentages retained progress across interrupted magazine.
Result distinguishes assisted shots, tap aims, route/approach assists and actual eliminations.
frustrating: Lateral movement plus FIRE drag failed to finish opening guard and lost its screen position.
Two scene turns needed before charging guard was visible again.
Distant patrols remain small against grey architecture.
Route continuation included a near-wall view again.
failures: Opening guard was not downed by first manual batch.
Attempted post-DASH aim correction had no confirmed hit.
Took shield damage during guard correction, later travel and upload.
uncertainties: Displayed accuracy does not distinguish which early shot missed.
DASH activation and changed position do not prove charge interruption.
No second-attempt map or unassisted aim evaluation.
